description: Propose a change to a GitHub repository you connected as a pull request: creates a new eco/… branch from the base branch, commits the files you give (full new content per file) and opens a pull request for a person to review and merge. Never writes to an existing branch.

base.description: Branch to merge into; the default branch when omitted.

body.description: Pull request description in Markdown: what changes and why.

files.description: The files to create or replace, each with its full new content.

content.description: The complete new content of the file.
